The '''Rock-eater''' was a [[vorantikus]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was [[Death/Legends|slain]] in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Rock-eater appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Voss]]. It is the final encounter of the heroic mission Rock-Eaters. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
